intent: One data cell of a table row.
typical_uses: One value of a record in a TableBody row
A totals value in a TableFooter row

dont_use_when.situation: The heading of a column or of a row

invariants.text: Cell text does not wrap: a long value widens its column and the table's wrapper scrolls horizontally. Under Table's `variant="collection"` cell text wraps instead.
TableCell is box-sizing border-box, so a width set through style or className includes the cell's padding; a cell holding a role="checkbox" descendant drops its inline-end padding.

anti_patterns.dont: Set display flex or grid on a TableCell to lay out its content
anti_patterns.do_instead: Wrap the content in an inner element and lay that out; a non-table display makes the cell stop being a table-cell box, so vertical-align no longer applies and the 40px floor becomes a fixed height

a11y.by: table.test.tsx asserts getAllByRole('cell') finds all four data cells of the rendered table

bad.title: A flex layout on the cell itself
bad.why: The cell stops being a table-cell box and loses its vertical centering; put the flex layout on an element inside the cell.
